lines.text: Joash became king in the seventh year of Jehu and did right while Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
Joash told the priests to collect sacred money for temple repairs, but by his twenty-third year the damage was unrepaired.
Jehoiada set a chest beside the altar, and the royal scribe and the high priest counted its money.
Hazael king of Aram captured Gath, so Joash sent him sacred objects and bronze from the temple and palace.
Joash's servants killed him at Beth-millo, and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.
